correctness.rationale: PASS: For independent sets in C7 strong square, every row is one of 29 independent C7 masks and successive cyclic layers are compatible iff their selected second-coordinate residues have cyclic distance >=2. An independently implemented 7-layer integer-polynomial DP has degree 10 and leading coefficient 980. Three displayed 10-point representatives were independently checked pairwise nonconfusable; their full orbits under all 392 maps (x,y)->(s_x x+a,s_y y+b) and coordinate swap have sizes 392,392,196. The three orbits are disjoint, so their 980 members exhaust ALL maximum sets by the separately counted leading coefficient; stabilizers 1,1,2. Fingerprints independently recomputed as (0,2),(1,1),(1,2), with the coordinate multiplicity profile from the complete orbit union. This establishes the finite orbit classification without relying on the package verifier's exit code. No claim is made that the natural group is the entire graph automorphism group, nor concerning higher strong powers.
